name: codex-engineering-lifecycle
description: A three-task Codex workflow for confirmed requirements, independent plan and code review, Goal-mode delivery, merge, release, and feature closure.

interface.shortDescription: Three-task feature delivery with independent review.
interface.longDescription: Initialize Requirements, Engineering Main, and Engineering Review tasks, then carry an immutable feature through confirmation, technical-plan review, serialized Goal-mode development, exact-head code review, merge, explicit release authorization, and auditable closure.
defaultPrompt: Use $engineering-requirements to turn my feature request into confirmed requirements.
Use $engineering-main to continue the authorized feature lifecycle.
